title: AI phone ordering: a voice agent working with a live backend in real time
alias: AI voice ordering with POS integration
summary: A coffee shop ordering demo built to show a voice AI agent working with a real backend in real time. Every item is a tool call into the order system, nothing exists until a handler has recorded it, and the page shows each call as it happens.
scenario: A coffee order by phone or browser, with a live ticket drawn from what the backend recorded and the tool calls listed under it
